facility.name: Lil' Cats Child Development Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Four employee files were reviewed.  Employee #1 is missing a photo id, cpr/1st aid card, and notarized affidavit of employment.  Employee #2 is missing a hire date and a notarized affidavit of employment.  Employee #3 is missing a photo id and cpr/1st aid card.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Four children's files were reviewed.  Child #3 does not have a signed parent's rights form. Child #4 Is missing an address for the emergency contact and a health statement from page 4 is not checked and signed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: During inspection the infant rooom was too dark and my eyes had to adjust.  A current was opened to provide more light.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: During the inspection it was found that the director has not enrolled in any classes to complete business management training for her ceritifcate and is not fullfilling the role of director as she is required to be in a classroom all day.  The records and required documents are not maintained.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employee Required: During inspection at naptime there were two teachers in the building each supervising a group of children and an additional person was not in the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employee Required (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio: Naptime ratios require that all classrooms with children be supervised with a caregiver in the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio (26 TAC §746.1613(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: During inspection, current staff do not have a peronnel file showing hire dates, birthdate, graduation info, that handbooks have been reviewed and that orientation was completed.  There are no training certificates available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: During the inspection it was found that the operation does not have any current enrollment forms for the children including shot records, emergency medical treatment permission, etc.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised: During inspection the infant room was left unsupervised with sleeping infants with the door closed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))

occurrences.finding: Operating in compliance with MS Rules Licensed: During inspection it was found that the permit holder is not ensuring that the director and staff are following the minimum standards including record keeping, supervision, and ratios.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Operating in compliance with MS Rules Licensed (26 TAC §746.113(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: The record was not available at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: During inspection children were observed watching a move during rest time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: The nappingn room needs additional lighting where eyes do not have to adjust to see the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records: The records were not available during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: During inspection, a caregiver was not aware of how many children were in their care.  During inspection, the caregiver identified and counted children and got a list to check name to face.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent: Infant daily sheets are not being sent home regularly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Share with Parent (26 TAC §746.2431)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: During inspection infants were observed walking around with food and bottle.  Bottles and food were removed during inspectionl.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During inspection a caregiver was found to be working with children without an eligibility.  The caregiver was removed from the operation during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During inspection the infant room was observed to have six infants with 1 caregiver.  The room came into ratio when another caregiver was brought into the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Cover All Stored Food: Food was observed uncovered in the frigerator but was covered during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Cover All Stored Food (26 TAC §746.3317(8))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked: Gate exit on playground has wrapped chain that cannot be easily accessed to escape by caregivers in the event of an emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked (26 TAC §746.4309)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Operation does not have a fire inspection under the new permit number.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits: Prek room has chairs in front of outdoor exit door and door cannot be easily exited in the event of an emergency and cannot be accessed to get to the  playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits (26 TAC §746.5209(c))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: Operation does not have a current health inspection under new permit number.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
